replacements.MCP separa host, clientes y servidores:: MCP separates host, clients, and servers: resources and prompts cross toward host policy, while tools must cross approval and authorization before producing external effects
replacements.El host conecta servidores sin cederles: The host connects servers without surrendering context or action policy
replacements.Los clientes MCP crean conexiones intero: MCP clients create interoperable connections. The host preserves isolation, consent, and composition; a tool with real effects must still cross authorization and the downstream system boundary.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable de host, clientes,: Scrollable diagram of MCP host, clients, servers, and trust boundaries
replacements.MCP como protocolo dentro de varias fron: MCP as a protocol across multiple trust boundaries
replacements.El usuario y el modelo viven en un host: The user and model live in a policy-enforcing host. The host creates two separate clients, each connected to one server. Resources and prompts return as inputs toward the host. A tool proposal first passes host policy and approval, then the corresponding client and server, MCP authorization, and downstream authorization before producing an external effect. The modern 2026 path carries version and capability metadata per request; initialize appears only for legacy compatibility.
replacements.resources / prompts → candidatos e instr: resources / prompts → candidates and non-privileged instructions
replacements.datos o instrucciones hacia el host: data or instructions toward the host
replacements.<strong>Interoperabilidad no es autorida: Interoperability is not authority. MCP standardizes the path between host and server; the host still decides what content enters the model and which action may cross a boundary. A successful call also does not prove that the downstream effect was authorized or correct.
